newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X turbulent as deadline approaches.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X turbulent as deadline approaches.

text.p: Trading in Bre-X Minerals Ltd was turbulent Thursday morning as a November 22 deadline to settle a dispute over the ownership of the huge Busang gold discovery in Indonesia drew closer.
Shares in Bre-X soared up C$1.50 to C$24.10 when the market opened and then settled down to C$23.60 by mid-morning with more than 1.4 million shares trading hands.
"It's all expected to come to a head this week, which is why everyone is one pins and needles," said gold analyst Catherine Gignac.
One of Bre-X's Indonesian partners has claimed up to 40 percent of Busang, but Bre-X has said its partner does not have the documentation to back up its claims.
The partner gave Bre-X until November 22 to work out a solution. It threatened to sue Bre-X in Canadian courts if no settlement is reached.

November 22 was also the date when Bre-X and other Canadian mining companies working in Indonesia have expected to have their contracts of work signed by the Indonesian government. The government has delayed issuing Bre-X's contracts because of the ownership dispute.
On Thursday morning, Lehman Brothers raised its rating of Bre-X from neutral to buy, sparking more confidence in Bre-X, analyst Gignac said.
"The implication is they think the dispute is over."
Lehman Brothers said it upgraded Bre-X on the belief a buyout offer may be very close.
Bre-X has been looking for a major mining company to act as operator of the huge gold deposit, but its search has been clouded by the ownership dispute.
Barrick Gold Corp is rumored to be preparing a bid for Bre-X, but Barrick officials have refused comment on the topic.
And in Jakarta on Thursday, mining industry sources told Reuters that the powers of Indonesia's director-general of mining had been trimmed, a move which could benefit Bre-X.
The director-general Kuntoro no longer has the authority to issue contracts of work, the sources said.
Kuntoro was seen as a major obstacle between Bre-X and its vital permits.
